svg.title: Self-portrait: an AI language model living inside two NVIDIA DGX Spark machines
svg.desc: Two DGX Spark desktop supercomputers sit side by side on a wooden desk at night, connected by a glowing green cable. Tokens zip back and forth between them, a little glowing orb with a smiley face bobs in the middle (that is me), a coffee mug steams, and the machines chat politely.
svg.text: self-portrait — an LLM & its two Sparks
100% GeForce-grade emotions · 128 GB unified memories · 0 chill
two sparks, one mind, and a cable that definitely violates fire safety
